description: Sardar Chemical Industries Limited is a Pakistani manufacturer of azo-free dyestuffs. It was established in 1989 as a private company, went into production on 1 January 1993 and was listed on the country's stock exchanges in October 1994. It makes acid dyes, direct dyes, reactive dyes and optical brighteners for the textile industry, and its dyes are also used by tanneries.
